correctness.rationale: The proper-suffix criterion yields an exhaustive two-/four-run factor classification, with precise boundary conditions at equal zero runs. Literal independent enumeration agrees on 2401 complete factor sets and their length spectra. The exact three-case deficit proof proves all-length extremality and every optimizer. Geometric-series decomposition proves the generating function algebraically. A Dirichlet limit and four rational rectangle integrals prove both limiting moments; all rational integrations were checked independently. Finite checks are corroborative rather than substitutes for proof.

Targeted published-record searches yielded no equivalent statement in the sources compared. Residual unindexed-literature risk remains.

value.rationale: This solves an infinite natural fixed-run family for a standard factor-complexity statistic. The exact factor-length polynomial is a structural classification; the three-unit gap to the unrestricted sharp bound and one/two rigid optimizers at every length are exact extremal results. The rational aggregate generating function and nondegenerate Dirichlet law with rational variance contribute a different sampling regime from published i.i.d. expectations. It is neither a renaming nor a table extension.
